description_text: DSS/ITS has requested to utilize the two-year renewal option to the current contract with Prutech Solutions Inc (BID # DSS-ITS-C-20230810-1; PIN: 24GPMIT14710). The original contract expires on Dec 31, 2026. The renewal period is from Jan 1, 2027 to Dec 31, 2028 in the amount of $ 2,608,000.00. The vendor will provide consulting services for the Coordinated Assessment and Placement Systems/CAS, ACCESS HRA Releases and Public Engagement Unit Systems.
